title: Exposing flaws of generative model evaluation metrics and their unfair treatment of diffusion models
tldr_zh: 最大规模人评实验：现有生成评测指标与人评无强相关，Inception 特征压低扩散模型排名，建议换 DINOv2 特征。
tldr_en: Largest human evaluation shows no metric strongly correlates with human judgment; Inception features unfairly rank diffusion models lower; DINOv2 features proposed.
